sources.why: The repo this one forked from. These are the skills worth tracking upstream rather than owning — see docs/adr/0001.

skills.name: code-review
skills.why: Reviews changes since a fixed point on two axes — repo standards and the originating spec.

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.why: Deep-module vocabulary. Shared dependency of grilling and improve-codebase-architecture.

skills.name: diagnosing-bugs
skills.why: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.why: Maintains ubiquitous language and ADRs. Shared dependency of grill-with-docs.

skills.name: grill-me
skills.why: User-invoked entry point to the grilling interview.

skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.why: Grilling that writes ADRs and a glossary as it goes. Needs domain-modeling.

skills.name: grilling
skills.why: The interview engine itself. Required by grill-me and grill-with-docs.

skills.name: improve-codebase-architecture
skills.why: Scans for deepening opportunities and grills through the one you pick. Needs codebase-design.

skills.name: prototype
skills.why: Throwaway prototypes to sanity-check a state model or UI before committing to it.

skills.name: research
skills.why: Delegates reading legwork to a background agent and lands findings as Markdown in the repo.

sources.why: Vercel's public skill collection; only the discovery skill is curated from it.

skills.name: find-skills
skills.why: Finds and installs skills on demand — the discovery front-end to everything else.
